It stars [[Atul Kulkarni]], [[Ashwini Bhave]], [[Parul Gulati]] and [[Neil Bhoopalam]].{{cite web |title=The Raikar Case Web Series (2020) {{!}} Release Date, Review, Cast, Trailer, Watch Online at JioCinema, Voot |url=https://www.gadgets360.com/entertainment/the-raikar-case-web-series-117733 |website=[[NDTV|Gadgets 360]] |access-date=7 July 2023 |language=en}}{{cite web |title=The Raikar Case (2020) |url=https://www.avclub.com/tv/reviews/the-raikar-case-2020 |website=[[The A.V. Club]] |access-date=7 July 2023 |language=en}} ==Cast== * [[Atul Kulkarni]] as Yashwant Naik Raikar * [[Ashwini Bhave]] as Sakshi Naik Raikar * [[Ajay Purkar]] as Rajshekahar Apte * Honey Kamboj as Tarun Naik Raikar * [[Kunal Karan Kapoor]] as Mohit Naik Raikar * [[Mohit Chauhan (actor)|Mohit Chauhan]] as Vinayak Naik Raikar * [[Neil Bhoopalam]] as [[Superintendent of police (India)|SP]] John Pereira * [[Parul Gulati]] as Etasha Naik Raikar * Manava Arun Naik as Anandi Apte * Vaishnavi Kadam as Manika Apte * [[Lalit Prabhakar]] as Eklavya * Prakash Ramchandani as Jagdish Apte * Reena Wadhwa as Lily D'Silva Naik Raikar * Saloni Khanna as Mini, Eklavya's Fiancé ==Episodes== * Episode 1- Suicide Or Murder ?? * Episode 2- Hunt For The Killer. * Episode 3- The Evidence Doesn't Lie. * Episode 4- Hidden Secret, Buried Truth * Episode 5- Raikar's Vs Raikar's * Episode 6- Truth Over Family? * Episode 7- Whodunnit? ==Release== The series was released on 9 April 2020 and it is now available on the popular OTT platform [[Voot]].{{cite news |last=Rajpal |first=Roktim |title='The Raikar Case': This Voot Select offering makes a decent impact |url=https://www.deccanherald.com/entertainment/the-raikar-case-this-voot-select-offering-makes-a-decent-impact-822938.html |access-date=7 July 2023 |work=[[Deccan Herald]] |date=8 April 2020 |language=en}} == Reception == Reviewing for ''[[The Indian Express]]'' Arushi Jain wrote "The main selling point of The Raikar Case is its able cast. Atul Kulkarni, who plays the family patriarch, is as good as he has always been. He plays both the suspect of a murder and a victim of politics convincingly. Ashvini Bhave's experience shows in her performance as she plays Kulkarni's wife Sakshi."{{cite news |last=Jain |first=Arushi |title=The Raikar Case review: An engaging whodunnit with compelling performances |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/web-series/the-raikar-case-review-atul-kulkarni-parul-gulati-voot-select-6353190/ |url-access=limited |access-date=7 July 2023 |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=9 April 2020 |language=en}} ''[[The Times of India]]'' wrote "Each episode ends on a cliffhanger, making you want to jump right over to the next one. Though, after a point, the drama does become predictable and the pace too tends to slow down."{{cite news |last=Khurana |first=Archika |title=The Raikar Case Season 1 Review : An engaging whodunnit |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/web-series/reviews/hindi/the-raikar-case/the-raikar-case-season-1/seasonreview/76172870.cms |access-date=6 July 2023 |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=5 June 2020}}{{rating|3.5|5}} Ruchi Kaushal of ''[[Hindustan Times]]'' praised star cast performances and wrote "Atul is exemplary as he exudes power on one hand but appears vulnerable and fragile in circumstances not in his favour. Ashwini Bhave makes a wonderful comeback in a meaty role. Neil and Parul Gulati emerge as the central leads and do justice to the task at hand."{{cite news |last=Kaushal |first=Ruchi |title=The Raikar Case review: The whodunnit has more family drama than suspense |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/tv/the-raikar-case-review-atul-kulkarni-neil-bhoopalam-s-whodunnit-has-more-family-drama-than-suspense/story-ui0E29OwpGZx9eiurromTO.html |access-date=7 July 2023 |work=[[Hindustan Times]] |date=11 April 2020 |language=en}} A critic from ''[[Pinkvilla]]'' rated the series 3 stars out of 5 and wrote "The Raikar Case couldn't have come through without good performances."{{cite news |last=Sharma |first=Dishya |title=The Raikar Case Review: Ashvini Bhave stands out in this star studded concoction of murder mystery and drama |url=https://www.pinkvilla.com/entertainment/reviews/raikar-case-review-ashwini-bhave-stands-out-star-studded-concoction-murder-mystery-and-drama-522880 |access-date=7 July 2023 |work=[[Pinkvilla]] |date=9 April 2020 |language=en}}{{rating|3|5}} ''[[Scroll.in]]'' reviewed and wrote "Writers Bijesh Jayarajan, Karmanya Ahuja and Anitha Nair use the Rashomon technique to present varying possibilities. Repeated information (the dialogue is by Chinmay Mandlekar) and over-use of the structure waste precious minutes."{{cite news |last=Jhunjhunwala |first=Udita |title='The Raikar Case' review: Web series has plenty of family drama but not enough mystery |url=https://scroll.in/reel/958648/the-raikar-case-review-web-series-has-plenty-of-family-drama-but-not-enough-mystery |access-date=6 July 2023 |work=[[Scroll.in]] |date=9 April 2020}} ''[[The New Indian Express]]'' wrote "It would have made for a good feature film too. But despite the makers choosing the web-series format, the all-important character arcs of these family members feel underdeveloped."{{cite news |last=Ramachandran |first=Avinash |title='The Raikar Case' review: Engaging family drama weighed down by a middling whodunit |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/entertainment/review/2020/apr/11/the-raikar-case-review-engaging-family-drama-weighed-down-by-a-middling-whodunit-2128447.html |access-date=6 July 2023 |work=[[The New Indian Express]] |date=11 April 2020}} == References == {{reflist}} == External links == * {{IMDb title|id=tt11953232}} * [https://www.voot.com/shows/the-raikar-case/239633 The Raikar Case on Voot] {{DEFAULTSORT:Raikar Case, The}} [[Category:2020 Indian television series debuts]] [[Category:Hindi-language web series]]
extract: The Raikar Case is a Hindi-language murder-mystery web series directed by Aditya Sarpotdar and produced by Sukesh Motwani, Mautik Tolia and Persis Siganporia. It stars Atul Kulkarni, Ashwini Bhave, Parul Gulati and Neil Bhoopalam.
